item.title: Jason Hehir On ‘SCTV: The Greatest Show You’ve Never Heard Of,’ Martin Scorsese’s Unreleased Reunion & Catherine O’Hara [Interview]
item.description: For anyone who grew up in Canada during the 1970s and ’80s, “ SCTV ” was practically a religion, an absurdist, wonderfully irreverent comedy institution that helped shape an entire generation’s sense of humor. Yet, south of the border, the show remained something of a cult curiosity, even as its astonishing ensemble of comedians went on to become household names. Now, 50 years after its debut, Netflix has finally given the series its due, making the original episodes available to stream alongside an affectionate, often hilarious, and unexpectedly moving documentary about its creation and enduring influence. Continue reading Jason Hehir On ‘SCTV: The Greatest Show You’ve Never Heard Of,’ Martin Scorsese’s Unreleased Reunion & Catherine O’Hara [Interview] at The Playlist.
